profile_text.body:
Glean is a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in Palo Alto, CA, that describes itself as a Work AI platform connected to enterprise data, designed to help employees find information, create content, and automate workflows. The company emphasizes that its platform is built for enterprise use from the outset, with a focus on secure, explainable, and permission-aware answers. Its site cites deployments at companies including Booking.com, Ericsson, GCash, and Zillow, with Zillow reporting an 80% adoption rate.

Glean's core product is an enterprise AI platform combining knowledge search, an AI assistant, and agent orchestration across more than 100 connectors to business data sources. The platform handles data access governance and permission-aware retrieval, meaning users see only results they are authorized to access. The site also references an AI Stack Score tool aimed at engineering teams, intended to assess performance across delivery speed, incident response, and context access.

The site's held facts note a registered MCP server under the identifier co.gleanit/gleanit, described as enabling search, reading, and writing of highlights, notes, screenshots, collections, projects, and tags within the Gleanit application. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded for the company in the available data.
